# Shader standard library (`_std`)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-shader-stdlib-docs.ts from the module doc headers. Do not hand-edit. -->

Shared WGSL helpers in [`public/shaders/_std/`](../public/shaders/_std/). Use these instead of pasting a private
hash / fbm / ACES into a shader: a fix to a shared function is one commit, a fix to 1,265 copies is
dozens of batches.

**Status (slice 1 of the stdlib plan):** the modules, their golden tests and this page exist; the
`#import name from "_std/<module>"` linker is the next slice. Until it lands, `_std` files cannot be
`#include`d (the include contract still rejects subdirectories), so copy the function *verbatim* —
body-identical copies are what the dedupe codemod will replace with an import, pixel-identically.

## Conventions

- `hashNM`: N input components, M output components (`hash21` is `vec2 → f32`). The catalog also uses
  `hash12` for `vec2 → f32`; `_std` does not.
- Hashes are integer PCG (no `sin`-`fract`), bit-identical across GPU vendors. Float inputs hash their IEEE bits;
  noise lattices hash the integer cell (`hashCell*`).
- Every tonemap operator clamps input to ≥ 0 (the catalog ACES maps −0.18 to ≈ 0.68).
- fbm-style sums are normalised by total amplitude, so the stated range holds for any octaves/gain.
- Audio is `plasmaBuffer[0].xyz` and FFT bins `extraBuffer[5..132]` — never `u.config.yzw`.

## Testing

- `npx vitest run src/shaderlib` — header/doc contract, naga validation of every module and of the
  golden harness, PCG goldens against an exact TypeScript reference.
- `npm run shaderlib:golden` — executes every case in `src/contracts/shaderlib_golden.json` on SwiftShader
  WebGPU. `-- --update` recaptures the implementation-pinned cases; `analytic` cases are never rewritten.
- `npm run shaderlib:docs` regenerates this page (`-- --check` verifies it).
